description: Brazilian fiscal documents for Node.js: NFS-e Nacional emission (DPS, XMLDSig, Sefin mTLS client, cancellation, ADN, DANFSe)
rules: Persist the signed DPS and set sentAt before every SefinClient.emit call.
After a SefinError with kind 'unavailable', call findAccessKeyByDpsId before resending, and never allocate a new nDPS for that note.
Exports (tribISSQN 3) need serv.comExt, valores.cPaisResult and a taker identified by NIF or cNaoNIF with a foreign address.
